rule: A control-plane or executable change required by an accepted PROJECT_CHANGE_REQUIRED study may be materialized only into a separate implementation PR. The permanent inbox may carry proposal and payload bytes, but protected main must first authorize the exact candidate SHA-256, exact proposal SHA-256, exact operation-set SHA-256, and every operation must bind an exact main preimage and payload SHA-256. The write-scoped runner executes only code from protected main, never executes source-branch payloads, seals the exact generated diff, and leaves merge authority to the ordinary protected PR path.
